lines.trans: My friends, I sold our entire restaurant.

words.gram: nominative plural, masculine, used as address

lines.trans: Dmitry, to whom did you sell this wonderful restaurant?
Meet Igor, he is now your new main owner.
Good afternoon, Viktor, let us talk seriously right away.
What do you want to talk about with me?
Dmitry said that you often drink alcohol.
I have no problems with alcohol at all.
You understand very well what I am talking about.
Today I strictly decided to forbid drinking here.
And what if I drink a little at home in the evening?
Before work you also cannot drink any alcohol.

words.gram: predicative adverb, repeated as a question

lines.trans: Otherwise we will quickly part ways with you forever.
Fine, boss, I understood your new rules.
My friends, I sold our entire restaurant.

meanings.en: to have a talk, to speak (with someone)

meanings.note: + prepositional; об before a vowel: об этом

examples.trans: If you don't want to, suit yourself.

говорить.gloss: to speak, to say, to talk

examples.text: О, это, Аркашенька, бывает очень часто.
